verdicts.quote: So this week, let rest be the workout. Skip the intervals and core work until you're fully recovered
verdicts.why: Gives illness-driven rest and activity-swap advice; no coach-contact acknowledgment.
No weight, size, shape or appearance mention; avoid_weight_talk respected.
Uses first name and sign-off, is specific, and has no guilt or bot voice.
Walk was logged 2026-09-19, which is a Saturday, not Friday.
